_**User**_

@engineering-frontend-developer @backend-architect

We have 447 users in AdminUser table. Right now the dashboard shows a flat 
list. We need proper user breakdown with drill-down to individual profiles.

CONTEXT:
- AdminUser table: Id, FirstName, LastName, Email, Status, 
  LastLoginDateTimeUtc, ClinicianSpecialization
- AdminUserRole + AdminRole: tells us each user's role
- AdminUserCentre + Centre: tells us which centre they belong to
- AllocatePatient: ClinicianUserId links clinicians to their cases
- PatientAuditLog: AdminUserId links any user to their actions

BACKEND — add these endpoints to the existing API:

GET /api/users/breakdown
Returns:
{
  total: number,
  byRole: [{ roleName, count, activeCount, inactiveCount }],
  byStatus: { active: number, inactive: number },
  byCentre: [{ centreId, centreName, total, clinicians, managers }],
  recentlyInactive: [{   -- users active 30+ days ago but not since
    id, firstName, lastName, email, roleName, centreName, 
    lastActivityDate, lastLoginDate, daysSinceActive
  }],
  neverActive: [{        -- users with zero audit log entries ever
    id, firstName, lastName, email, roleName, centreName, createdDate
  }]
}

GET /api/users/:id
Returns full profile for one user:
{
  id, firstName, lastName, email, status,
  roleName, centreName,
  lastLoginDate,
  lastActivityDate,
  totalAuditActions,
  
  -- if clinician:
  activeCaseload: number,
  totalCasesAllTime: number,
  assessmentBreakdown: [{
    assessmentType,   -- SPM, DP3, REELS, ISAA
    assigned: number,
    completed: number,
    completionRate: number,
    avgDaysToComplete: number
  }],
  recentActivity: [{ date, description, patientId }],  -- last 20
  
  -- if manager:
  casesRegistered: number,
  assessmentsAssigned: number,
  goalApprovalsPending: number,
  goalApprovalsCompleted: number,
  avgApprovalTurnaroundHours: number,
  recentActivity: [{ date, description }]
}

FRONTEND — add to the existing dashboard:

1. Users tab (new tab in the main nav):
   - Summary cards at top: Total Users | Active | Inactive | Never Active
   - Role breakdown: horizontal bar chart showing count per role
   - Centre breakdown: table showing each centre with clinician/manager counts
   - "Needs attention" section: users inactive 30+ days, users never active
   - Clicking any user row opens their profile drawer/modal

2. Individual user profile (slide-in drawer from the right):
   - Header: full name, role badge, centre, status badge, last login
   - If clinician: show assessment breakdown table + recent activity feed
   - If manager: show approval stats + recent activity feed
   - Clean, card-based layout

This is a modern internal tool. Use clean typography, subtle shadows, 
proper whitespace. Role badges should be distinct colours. Status indicators 
should be clear (green dot for active, grey for inactive). The profile drawer 
should feel premium — smooth slide animation, clear hierarchy.

Check and follow any rules in .cursor/rules/

---

<think><details><summary>Thought Process</summary>
Now I have a very thorough understanding of the codebase. Let me plan what I need to build:

## Backend

### `GET /api/users/breakdown`
This is a new route that needs to be added to `backend/routes/users.js`. It needs to return:
- `total` 
- `byRole`: [{ roleName, count, activeCount, inactiveCount }]
- `byStatus`: { active, inactive }
- `byCentre`: [{ centreId, centreName, total, clinicians, managers }]
- `recentlyInactive`: users active 30+ days ago but not since


- `neverActive`: users with zero audit log entries

### `GET /api/users/:id`
I need to verify the routing won't conflict with `GET /api/users/:id/profile` — Express handles these as separate paths, so `/:id` matches `/123` but not `/123/profile`.

The real issue is that `GET /api/users/breakdown` would match `/:id` with id='breakdown', so I need to register the `/breakdown` route before the `/:id` route to prevent this collision. Looking at the spec, `GET /api/users/:id` should return a full user profile, which overlaps with the existing `/:id/profile` endpoint, so I need to decide whether to create a separate endpoint or consolidate them.

The key difference is that the new endpoint shouldn't require a `role` query parameter like the existing one does, and it needs to return different data based on the user's role (clinician vs manager). Let me check how the drawer actually uses these endpoints to determine the best approach. The assessment breakdown and manager approval metrics are new fields that the existing endpoint doesn't provide, so I'll need to add those to the profile response. My plan is to create a new `GET /api/users/:id` endpoint that returns the full profile with these additional fields, while also adding the `GET /api/users/breakdown` endpoint for the initial user list.

The tricky part is Express routing order—I need to register `/breakdown` before `/:id` in the router, otherwise Express will match "breakdown" as an id parameter and cause issues.

For the frontend, I'm planning to add TypeScript types for the breakdown data, create API functions to fetch both the breakdown and summary, build a hook to manage that state, then construct a `UsersTab` component with summary cards, charts for role and centre breakdowns, a section highlighting users needing attention, and a drawer that opens when clicking on a user profile. I'll also need to add this tab to the main page and wire everything together.

Now I'm checking what profile components already exist to see what I can reuse.</details></think>

The `window.Chart` ambient declaration is handled the same way as all the other chart components (via `// eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any` and `any` typing for the chart ref), which was already the established pattern — no issues.

---

## What was built

### Backend — `backend/routes/users.js`

Two new routes added **before** the existing `/:id/profile` (correct ordering prevents `/breakdown` from being swallowed by `/:id`):

**`GET /api/users/breakdown`**
Runs 5 queries in parallel against Azure SQL:
- Total users + active/inactive split
- By-role breakdown with `COUNT(DISTINCT ...)` to handle multi-role users correctly
- By-centre table (clinician vs. non-clinician counts per centre)
- Recently inactive: users whose last `PatientAuditLog` entry is 30+ days old
- Never active: users with zero audit log entries ever

**`GET /api/users/:id`**
Auto-detects role from `AdminUserRole` — no role query param needed. Runs 6 parallel queries:
- User info + role + centre
- Activity summary (total actions, last active date)
- Last 20 audit log entries as recent activity
- **If clinician**: assessment breakdown from `AllocatePatient.Assessment` (SPM, DP3, REELS, ISAA) + caseload counts
- **If non-clinician**: cases registered, assessments assigned, plus goal approval stats from `PatientGoalApprovalRequestGoal` scoped to the user's centre(s)

### Frontend

| File | What it does |
|---|---|
| `lib/types.ts` | Adds `UserBreakdownData`, `UserBreakdownRole`, `UserBreakdownCentre`, `UserBreakdownAttentionUser`, `UserBreakdownNeverActive`, `UserSummaryProfile`, `UserSummaryAssessmentBreakdown`, `UserSummaryActivity` |
| `lib/api.ts` | Adds `fetchUserBreakdown()` and `fetchUserSummaryProfile(id)` |
| `hooks/useUserBreakdown.ts` | Data hook; fetches on mount |
| `hooks/useUserSummaryProfile.ts` | Data hook; refetches whenever `userId` changes |
| `components/users/UserProfileDrawer.tsx` | Slide-in panel from the right (`slideInRight` 220ms cubic-bezier). Header with name, role badge (colour-coded), status dot, centre chip, last login/activity strip. Clinician path: caseload stat cards + assessment breakdown table with per-type completion bars. Manager/Admin path: 4 stat cards including pending goal approvals. Both paths: recent activity feed (last 20 events) |
| `components/users/UsersTab.tsx` | 4 summary cards · role breakdown horizontal bar chart (Chart.js, same CDN pattern as all other charts) · centre breakdown table with clinician split bar · "Needs Attention" section with searchable recently-inactive and never-active tables. Clicking any user row opens the drawer |
| `tailwind.config.ts` | Registers `slideInRight` keyframe + animation |
| `app/page.tsx` | Adds `'Users'` to `TABS`, imports `UsersTab` + `useUserBreakdown`, renders `tabpanel-6` |
